title: Curative Effect and Mechanism of Transcutaneous Auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation on Sleep Disorders of PD

sections.abstract: This study is a double-blind comparative study examining the curative effect and mechanism of the transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation treatment on non-motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease patients. The investigators hypothesize that treatment using transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation will improve the non-motor symptoms, such as improving sleep, and improve cortical activity simultaneously in Parkinson's disease patients.
